title: How to Make Oyakodon
titleJp: 親子丼[おやこどん]の作[つく]り方[かた]

sentences.jp: 今日[きょう]は、簡単[かんたん]な親子丼[おやこどん]の作[つく]り方[かた]を紹介[しょうかい]します。
sentences.en: Today I'll show you how to make a simple oyakodon.

sentences.jp: 鶏肉[とりにく]が「親[おや]」で、卵[たまご]が「子[こ]」なので、この名前[なまえ]になりました。
sentences.en: The chicken is the "parent" and the egg is the "child," so it got this name.

sentences.jp: 材料[ざいりょう]は、二人分[ふたりぶん]で鶏肉[とりにく]二百[にひゃく]グラム、玉[たま]ねぎ半分[はんぶん]、卵[たまご]三[みっ]つ、それからご飯[はん]です。
sentences.en: For two servings, the ingredients are 200 grams of chicken, half an onion, three eggs, and rice.

sentences.jp: まず、鶏肉[とりにく]を小[ちい]さく切[き]って、玉[たま]ねぎは薄[うす]く切[き]っておきます。
sentences.en: First, cut the chicken into small pieces and slice the onion thinly.

sentences.jp: 次[つぎ]に、なべに水[みず]としょうゆ、砂糖[さとう]、みりんを入[い]れて、火[ひ]にかけます。
sentences.en: Next, put water, soy sauce, sugar, and mirin into a pot and put it on the heat.

sentences.jp: 沸[わ]いたら、鶏肉[とりにく]と玉[たま]ねぎを入[い]れて、五分[ごふん]ぐらい煮[に]ます。
sentences.en: When it boils, add the chicken and onion and simmer for about five minutes.

sentences.jp: 鶏肉[とりにく]に火[ひ]が通[とお]ったら、よく混[ま]ぜた卵[たまご]を上[うえ]からゆっくり入[い]れます。
sentences.en: Once the chicken is cooked through, slowly pour the well-beaten eggs over the top.

sentences.jp: ふたをして、一分[いっぷん]ぐらい待[ま]ちます。
sentences.en: Put the lid on and wait about one minute.

sentences.jp: 卵[たまご]が固[かた]くなりすぎないように気[き]をつけてください。
sentences.en: Be careful that the eggs don't get too firm.

sentences.jp: 最後[さいご]に、温[あたた]かいご飯[はん]の上[うえ]にのせたら、できあがりです。
sentences.en: Finally, put it on top of warm rice, and it's done.

sentences.jp: 三十分[さんじゅっぷん]もかからないので、忙[いそが]しい日[ひ]の晩[ばん]ご飯[はん]にぴったりです。
sentences.en: It takes less than thirty minutes, so it's perfect for dinner on a busy day.

questions.q: Why is the dish called oyakodon ("parent and child bowl")?
choices: Parents and children often eat it together
The chicken is the "parent" and the egg is the "child"
A mother invented it for her child
It is served in two bowls, a big one and a small one

questions.q: How many eggs do you need for two people?
What does the writer tell you to be careful about?
choices: Not letting the eggs get too firm
Not cutting the chicken too small
Not using too much soy sauce
